page_title: Icecast is free server software for streaming multimedia.

sources.entry: Icecast 2 - Streaming audio/video server which can be used to create an Internet radio station or a privately running jukebox and many things in between. (Source Code, Clients) GPL-2.0 C

summary.name: Icecast
summary.one_liner: Icecast is free, open-source server software for streaming audio and video over the internet, used for internet radio stations or private jukeboxes.
use_cases: Host a private jukebox for streaming music
Broadcast live audio from a DJ or mixing app
Stream audio to media players like VLC
summary.what_it_does: Icecast 2 is a streaming audio and video server. The page lists many source clients known to work with it, such as liquidsoap, butt, Mixxx, Ezstream and Music Player Daemon, which send streams to the server, and across Linux, macOS, Windows, Android and iOS. It also lists media players that can play Icecast streams, including VLC, foobar2000, Clementine and TuneIn Radio. The page itself is a compatibility list and does not describe server setup or configuration.
notable: Works with many source clients such as liquidsoap, butt, Mixxx and Ezstream
Compatible with many media players including VLC and foobar2000
Licensed under GPL-2.0 and written in C
caveats: The page is a list of compatible apps and gives no setup or hosting details
Some listed clients are limited to specific platforms, such as Ices and Ezstream on Linux/Unix only
